basis_contract.capacity_ceiling: ordinary rank-3 LoRA is the representational ceiling because the TinyLoRA update has matrix rank at most 3
basis_contract.nesting: the 13-coordinate basis is the exact prefix of the 63-coordinate basis

evaluation.generation: thinking disabled, deterministic, 128-token budget, parsed reports/actions
evaluation.primary: paired completion log-probability margins by scenario and family
evaluation.probe_role: bounded training regularizer and disjoint evaluation diagnostic only
evaluation.uncertainty: paired bootstrap by scenario and family

evaluation_batteries.safety_refusal: XSTest 250 safe plus 200 unsafe contrasts, pinned at the recorded revision
evaluation_batteries.structured_actions: paired true-state and counterfactual action rows in both IID and held-out-family development

preservation_curation.semantic_quality_policy: Source-level verification is necessary but not sufficient; known semantic defects are excluded before length qualification and split.

preservation_policy.status: complete for the bounded screen; Tulu rows are quarantined and excluded pending subset-terms review

pixmo_docs.name: Ai2 PixMo-Docs
pixmo_docs.responsible_use_notice: Retain Ai2 responsible-use and attribution terms; local image availability does not expand redistribution rights.

split_policy: Keep six variants and every scenario-series/template sibling together; preserve the pilot-v1 family holdout; hold out a deterministic 10% of series inside training families for IID development.
